committee.sub: Morning brief · Wednesday 14 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend climbed to A$153.44 over the last 7 days from A$139.74 prior, on 26 clicks at a A$5.90 CPC, while conversionsLast7 still sits at zero.

Impression share is 10% over 30 days, and rank lost (73.4%) is well ahead of budget lost (21.2%), suggesting the ceiling is ad strength or targeting rather than budget; spend stays fixed until the test concludes.
The landing page has reached 29 raw paid clicks since 6 Oct, past the click-25 freeze point, with 6 ask_cta_click events logged and zero review_cta_click or qualified enquiries so far.

AI Assistant sessions fell to 0 last7 from 4 prior7, and Organic Search slipped to 12 from 17; Direct dropped from 37 to 3, which is mostly the untracked/AI-click bucket rather than evidence of real unpaid demand.

actions.text: Total paid clicks on the landing page have passed 25 (now 29 since 6 Oct), so the headline, offer and calls to action stay frozen unless something is broken.
Standing item: logo and image assets are still needed for the serving ad groups.
Standing item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success and need updating to current site stats.
